artifacts.prompt:
Create one emblem logo for BREAD & BLOOM. Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'BREAD & BLOOM'. Exact slogan: ''.
Render only the supplied exact text and nonempty slogan; the brand context is not additional lettering. Empty strings request no corresponding text.
Industry: a neighborhood bakery and breakfast café. Audience: everyday consumer audiences; independent lifestyle businesses.
Styles: soft scalloped bakery emblem. Original brief palette context: warm strawberry red, uniform white background.
Avoid: industrial or manufacturing aesthetic, mechanical brackets, cut-metal blocks and engineering crests, extra lettering, slogans or watermarks, mockup scenes, collage or presentation board, colored canvas or transparent background. Use cases: brand identity at 240px width and README.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: A friendly oval bakery emblem whose outer border has six large, shallow, softly scalloped lobes, like the edge of a paper pastry doily but very simplified. Inside, exact BREAD & BLOOM arranged as BREAD on the upper line, a modest & on its own short middle line, and BLOOM on the lower line. Use warm rounded flared-serif letters with open B/R counters, gently curved serifs and deliberate generous spacing. No tiny perimeter text. Two very small solid oval seed-like accents may sit left and right of the ampersand if they do not compete with lettering. A single solid strawberry-red ink; border and letters have related weights and ample gap. Emblem fills about 66% width, all type readable. No wheat wreath, ribbon, date, distressed stamp or engineering crest.. Assumptions: Fictional demonstration brand. Design decisions are assistant proposals; user preference is pending., Preserve the existing exact string and white-background collection intent., One independent original, square canvas. Color descriptions are intent, not certified pixel values..
Logo construction: Build an emblem with the supplied lettering enclosed in a coherent badge or seal. Keep the border separate from glyphs and preserve readable interior gaps. Use style references for broad construction traits, not their brand words or traced signature shapes. The identity should remain recognizable in a one-color silhouette at the intended use size. This construction check does not replace the requested palette or request an extra monochrome image.
Lettering fidelity: preserve every Unicode character, capitalization, punctuation, space and reading order in the applicable text. Keep Hangul syllable blocks intact; do not translate, romanize, abbreviate or substitute lookalike glyphs. Shape changes must keep required text readable, including counters and joins at the intended size.
Output one square PNG containing only this single identity on a uniform white background. Clean, crisp raster edges; do not add paper grain or texture to flat ink.
